source.text: With the axial strain held at zero a uniformly heated solid has sigma_z = -E alpha (T - Tref) and no radial or hoop stress. The most compressive cell is the hottest, the first fuel cell centre (600.369 K, rise 300.369 K), E 200 GPa, alpha 1e-5 per K.
source.check: FEED's real-solver test (tests/mechanicsSolver.test.ts, plane strain) reproduces sigma_z = -E alpha dT to 0.5 %.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin at 10 W/m in a 600 K coolant, both solids linear elastic (E 200 GPa, nu 0.3) stress-free at 300 K, constant conductivities; thermo-elastic, small strain, no creep, plasticity or swelling; axially fixed (plane strain)
